description:
Thoroughly map and close the remaining OpenAI API surface gaps while keeping the Anthropic boundary intact. This epic covers core generation/media gaps, built-in tool lifecycle support, file and vector-store utilities, background and batch execution surfaces, realtime, and explicit evaluation of OpenAI-native utility surfaces that may need provider-owned modules instead of planner creep.

```mermaid
graph LR
    A[Gap map and boundary] --> B[Media completion]
    A --> C[Files and vector stores]
    A --> D[Built-in tools lifecycle]
    A --> E[Background mode]
    A --> F[Batch API]
    A --> G[Realtime family]
    A --> H[MCP connectors and skills evaluation]
    C --> D
    D --> E
    D --> G
    E --> I[Docs fixtures specs reconciliation]
    F --> I
    G --> I
    H --> I
    B --> I
    C --> I
```

comments.text: Completed the OpenAI platform pass: media edits/translations, files/vector stores, batch/background, response utilities (delete/compact/input token count), conversations, videos, webhooks parsing, broader built-in tool coverage, and a provider-owned Realtime protocol family. Full verification is green: mix test, mix quality, mix docs, mix spec.check --base origin/main.

title: Close OpenAI platform surface gaps
